output.reply: Hi Maria, thanks for reaching out, and sorry about the duplicate charge. I can see why that's concerning. We'll look into the two $9.99 Lumen Plus charges dated the 3rd and issue a refund for the duplicate once it's confirmed. Refunds usually show on your card statement within 5–10 business days, depending on your bank. We'll email you as soon as the refund is processed. Best regards, Lumen Support

Hi there, thanks for the suggestion! Having to switch themes by hand every evening is a hassle, and it makes sense for Lumen to match your system setting automatically. I've passed your request for a 'follow system theme' option to our product team. I can't promise a timeline, but feedback like yours helps us decide what to build next. Thanks for using Lumen!

Hi there, I'm sorry about this charge, and I understand how frustrating it is to be billed after cancelling. I want to get this sorted out for you as quickly as possible. Could you please reply with the email address on your Lumen account and forward the cancellation confirmation email you received in March? Once we've verified the cancellation, we'll reverse the $120 annual charge and confirm the refund with you right away. We'll prioritize your case today, and you won't need to go through your bank. Thank you for your patience. The Lumen Support Team

Hi there, thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the trouble. Tables pasted from Google Sheets should keep their columns in Lumen, so this looks like a bug, especially since it worked last week. We've passed it to our engineering team. To help us reproduce it, could you send:

1. A sample of the cells you're copying, or a screenshot of the Sheets selection
2. How you're pasting (Ctrl/Cmd+V or right-click > Paste)
3. Whether it also happens in an incognito window with extensions disabled

In the meantime, you can try pasting into a new blank note or exporting the sheet as CSV and importing it. We'll update you as soon as we have a fix.

Best,
Lumen Support

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and it's smart to make a backup before you travel! Exporting your notes as Markdown is usually done from your account or settings area. Look for an Export or Backup option and choose Markdown as the format. If you have a lot of notes, the export may arrive as a .zip file with one Markdown file per note. Once it downloads, open a few files to check that everything came through correctly before you leave. If you can't find the export option, or the export doesn't include everything you expected, reply here with the device and app version you're using and we'll guide you through it. Safe travels!

Hi there, sorry you've been locked out of your Lumen account. Since the reset link goes to an inbox you can no longer reach, our support team will need to update the email on your account manually after verifying that you own it. To get started, please reply with: (1) the old email address on the account, (2) the new email address you'd like to use, and (3) any details that help confirm ownership, such as approximate signup date, names of a few notebooks, or billing details (last 4 digits of the card or an invoice number) if you're on a paid plan. If your company's IT team can briefly restore access to or forward mail from your old address, that's often the fastest route, since you could then use the reset link and change your email in Settings. Once we've verified your identity, we'll switch the address and help you sign back in. Thanks for your patience!

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! To share a notebook in Lumen, open the notebook you'd like to share and look for the Share option (usually in the notebook's menu or toolbar). From there, you can invite people by email and choose their access level, such as view-only or edit. They'll get an invitation to open the notebook. If you don't see the Share option or run into any trouble, reply with the device and app version you're using and we'll help you sort it out. Happy note-taking!

Hi there, I'm sorry the app is closing when you open notes with attached PDFs, especially with your exam on Friday. We've logged this as a bug and marked it high priority.

Your notes and attachments are stored in the cloud, so your slides should still be safe. To get to them before Friday, please try signing in to Lumen from a web browser or another device, such as a computer or tablet, and opening the notes there.

To help us fix the crash, could you reply with:
1. Your iPhone or iPad model and iOS version
2. The Lumen app version (Settings > About)
3. Whether every note with a PDF crashes, or only some of them

If the slides are still unavailable on other devices, let us know right away and we'll help you recover them before your exam.

Best,
Lumen Support

Thank you for reporting this quickly. We're treating it as a possible account compromise and have escalated it to our security team. Please take these steps now to secure your account:

1. Change your Lumen password to a strong one you don't use anywhere else. If you use the same password for your email, change that too.
2. Go to Settings > Security and choose 'Sign out of all devices' to end any sessions you don't recognize.
3. Turn on two-factor authentication.
4. Open each affected notebook's sharing settings and remove the address you don't recognize.

To help us investigate, please reply with the approximate date and time of the login alert and the names of the two notebooks that were shared. We'll review your account activity and follow up with what we find. If you notice any other changes, such as deleted notes or a changed email address, let us know right away.

Hi there, I'm sorry, I know how stressful this is with your presentation so close. I've flagged this as urgent and escalated it to our engineering team now. Even though the status page shows everything operational, we're treating your report as a possible outage and investigating right away.

While we look into it, these steps may get you to your notes in time:
1. Check offline copies: if anyone on your team has the desktop or mobile app open, notes synced to that device may still be readable offline. Please don't log out or reinstall, as that could clear the local copy.
2. Try another route: open Lumen in a web browser, or try a different network such as a phone hotspot. This helps us tell whether a firewall, VPN or office network is blocking the connection.
3. Find a copy elsewhere: look for any recent exports, shared links or emailed copies of the notes you need for the presentation.

To help us pinpoint the problem quickly, please reply with:
- Your workspace name
- Which apps you're using (web, desktop or mobile) and their versions
- Roughly when the error started
- Whether everyone is on the same network or VPN

We'll update you as soon as we know more. Good luck with your presentation.

Thanks for flagging this, and for the detailed description! You're right: the footer word count currently shows 0 for notes that contain only emoji. I've logged it as a bug with our team so the counter can be updated to handle emoji-only content properly. It won't affect your notes or data in any way. We appreciate you taking the time to let us know!

Hi there, thank you for the detailed feedback, and for using Lumen with your team of 12! I understand how frustrating it is when a paragraph disappears and there's no way to tell who removed it or when. I've logged your request for a named version history (showing who edited a note and when) with our product team. I've also noted that your team would pay extra for it, since that helps us prioritize. I can't promise a timeline yet, but we'll update you if there's news on this feature. In the meantime, if you can tell us which plan you're on and roughly when the paragraph went missing, we're happy to check whether we can help recover the lost content. Best regards, The Lumen Support Team

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the trouble. Sync stuck on 'Syncing...' across multiple devices, together with search returning no results, points to a possible issue on our side rather than your devices. I've escalated this to our engineering team, and you can check our status page for live updates. Your notes remain stored on each device, so please avoid signing out or reinstalling the app while we investigate, since that could remove unsynced changes. If you can reply with your app version and the approximate time sync last succeeded, that will help us look into your account specifically. We'll follow up as soon as we have an update.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! You can update the name shown next to your comments in your profile settings: open your account/profile settings in Lumen, edit the Display Name field, and save. Comments should then show your new name. If you've already changed it and still see your old nickname, try refreshing or signing out and back in, since older comments may take a moment to update. If it still shows the old name after that, reply here and we'll look into it. Happy note-taking!

Hi there, thanks for these suggestions! I can't promise if or when they'll ship, but requests like these help shape our roadmap, and we'll share news in our release notes. Thanks for helping us improve Lumen! - The Lumen Support Team

Hi there, I'm sorry. Seeing 'temporarily unavailable' when you sit down to work on a Monday is frustrating, and three weeks in a row is not acceptable. I've escalated this to our engineering team as a recurring outage and flagged the Monday-morning pattern so they can look for the cause. To help them, could you tell us your device model, OS version, Lumen app version, and roughly what time the error appears? In the meantime, the web app at lumen's website may still let you reach your notes. We'll update you as soon as we know more. Thank you for sticking with us.

I'm really sorry you've lost your meeting notes, and that this has now happened twice. We're treating this as an urgent data-loss issue and have escalated it to our engineering team. To help us investigate and try to recover your content, could you send us: the approximate time of each incident, which device and app version (or browser) you were using, the title of the affected note, and whether you were online or had a spotty connection at the time? Please don't delete or overwrite the empty note, since that may help us trace what happened. Until we've identified the cause, we recommend copying long notes to another location periodically as a precaution. We'll follow up as soon as we have more information.

Hi there, thanks for the suggestion! An Android home screen widget for Lumen sounds really useful, and I've passed your request along to our product team. We can't promise a timeline, but feedback like yours helps shape what we build next. If there's anything specific you'd want the widget to do, like quick note capture, showing pinned notes, or a checklist view, just reply and let us know. Thanks for using Lumen!

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the trouble. It looks like your $48 Lumen Team payment went through, but your account was not upgraded from the free plan. We're escalating this to our billing team so they can apply the Team plan to your account. Your teammates likely can't see shared notebooks because notebook sharing is a Team feature, so access should start working once the upgrade is applied. Thanks for your patience!

Hi there, sorry the Settings move caught you off guard. Having things shift after an update is frustrating. To turn off the weekly summary emails in the current version, go to [Settings > Notifications/Email path] and switch off 'Weekly summary'. The change takes effect right away, so you won't get next week's email. If you can't find the option or the emails keep coming, just reply here and we'll turn them off for you. We'll also pass your feedback about the menu change to our product team. Best, Lumen Support

¡Hola! Lamentamos que no puedas acceder a tu cuenta de Lumen. Te ayudamos con lo del correo de restablecimiento. Por favor, revisa lo siguiente: 1) Busca en las carpetas de spam, correo no deseado o promociones un mensaje de Lumen. 2) Asegúrate de usar el mismo correo con el que te registraste, sin errores tipográficos. 3) Si tu proveedor o tu empresa filtra correos, añade nuestro dominio a tus contactos seguros. 4) Espera unos minutos entre cada solicitud, ya que los enlaces anteriores dejan de ser válidos. Si aun así no recibes nada, respóndenos indicando el correo de tu cuenta, si te registraste con Google o Apple, y la fecha aproximada de tu último inicio de sesión exitoso. Verificaremos tu identidad y te ayudaremos a recuperar el acceso. Por tu seguridad, nunca nos envíes tu contraseña. ¡Gracias por tu paciencia!

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and congrats on making it to your second year of CS! I'm checking with our billing team on whether we currently offer a student discount for the Plus plan and what you'd need to verify your enrollment (for example, a school email address or student ID). I'll follow up with the details shortly. In the meantime, the Free plan is available for your notes, and if you upgrade later, everything you've created will carry over. Best, The Lumen Support Team

Hi there, thanks for reporting these two issues with Lumen desktop for Windows, and sorry for the trouble. We've logged both for our engineering team: (1) the app freezing for a few seconds when opening notebooks with more than 200 notes, and (2) Ctrl+B occasionally inserting a literal 'b' instead of applying bold. To help us investigate, could you share your Lumen app version (Help > About), your Windows version, and your keyboard layout/language? For the Ctrl+B issue, it would also help to know whether it happens in specific situations, e.g. right after switching notes, while text is selected, or when typing quickly. Your notes are safe in the meantime, and we'll follow up as soon as we have an update or a fix. Thanks for your patience!

Hi there, thank you for the kind words, and for being with Lumen for two years! It makes sense to want a clear answer before reorganizing years of research notes. I'm checking with our team on exactly how internal links behave when a note moves to a different notebook, and what happens to comments and edit history when two notebooks are merged. I'll follow up with a definitive answer rather than guess. In the meantime, before making any changes we recommend: (1) exporting a full backup of your notes, and (2) creating a small test notebook with a few linked notes and comments, then trying a move and a merge there first. That way you can see the results without risking your real data. We'll be in touch soon with the details. Best of luck with the reorganization and your research!

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and sorry your images aren't showing up after the Evernote import. Images appearing as broken icons usually means the attachments didn't transfer with the notes, so we'd like to look into what happened on your import. To help us investigate, could you tell us:

1. How you exported from Evernote (for example, an .enex file or a direct account connection).
2. Roughly how many notes are affected, and whether it's all images or only some.
3. Whether the images are broken on all your devices or just one (web, desktop or mobile).
4. The approximate date and time of the import.

Please hold off on re-importing until we've had a chance to look, since a second import could create duplicate notes. Once we know more, we'll let you know the best way to restore your images.

Thanks for your patience!
Lumen Support

Hi there, I'm sorry you're locked out, especially when you need your legal documents today. We'll do everything we can to help you regain access quickly.

Two things are going on, and here's how we can handle each:

1. Login lockout: This is usually temporary and lifts automatically after a short waiting period. Please avoid further login attempts for now, since they can extend the lockout.

2. Two-factor recovery: Because your 2FA device is broken and you don't have your recovery codes, we'll need to verify your identity before we can reset two-factor authentication on your account. To start, please reply with:
- The email address on your Lumen account
- Your approximate account creation date
- Your current plan and, if it's paid, the last 4 digits of the card on file or a recent invoice number
- The approximate date you last logged in successfully

Please do NOT send your password.

We've marked your ticket as high priority because of your deadline. Once we receive and confirm these details, we'll reset your 2FA so you can sign in and set it up again on a new device. When you're back in, we recommend saving a fresh set of recovery codes somewhere safe.

Best regards,
Lumen Support

Hi there, thanks for letting us know Lumen has been running slowly today, and sorry for the trouble. To help us track this down, could you share a few details?

1. Which platform and app version are you using (web, Windows, Mac, iOS, Android)?
2. Which actions feel slow (opening the app, loading notes, syncing, searching, typing)?
3. When did it start, and is it constant or on and off?
4. Does it also happen on another device or network?

In the meantime, please check our status page for any ongoing incidents. Restarting the app or signing out and back in can also help. We'll follow up as soon as we hear back.

Best,
Lumen Support

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and sorry to see you go. We can help you delete your Lumen account and the data associated with it. Deleting your account permanently removes your notes, notebooks, attachments, tags, and profile information, and it can't be undone. If you'd like to keep anything, please export your notes before going ahead. You can start the deletion from your account settings, or simply reply to confirm and we'll process it for you. I'll follow up with the exact timeline for when your data is fully removed from our active systems and backups, and we'll send you an email confirmation once the deletion is complete. Before we proceed, please also cancel any active paid subscription so you aren't billed again. Let us know if you have any other questions.

Hi there, thanks for the feedback, and fair point! Being able to sort notes alphabetically sounds like a simple but genuinely useful option. I've passed your request on to our product team. I can't promise a timeline, but requests like this help shape what we build next. In the meantime, if there's a particular view where alphabetical sorting would help most (e.g., the main notes list, notebooks, or search results), let us know and we'll add that detail to the request. Thanks for using Lumen!

Hi there, thanks for reporting this, and sorry your coworkers are seeing a 404 on your shared link (lumen.example/s/ab12). We've logged it as a bug and our team is looking into it. To help us find the cause, could you tell us: 1) Is the notebook's sharing still turned on, and is it set to 'Anyone with the link' or limited to specific people? 2) Does the link open for you in a private or incognito window? 3) Roughly when did you create or copy the link, and have you renamed or moved the notebook since? As a workaround, you could try turning sharing off and on again and copying a fresh link. Please note that no refund has been issued on this ticket. If you have a billing concern, just let us know and we'll handle it separately. We'll update you as soon as we know more.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and I understand you need this by end of day. [Agent: confirm whether Lumen has a native template feature. If it does, add the exact steps here. If not, keep the workaround below and consider logging a feature request.] In the meantime, here's a quick workaround: create a note with your standup structure, for example sections for Yesterday, Today and Blockers. Hi there, sorry about the red squiggles under our own name! Spellcheck in your notes typically comes from your browser or operating system, so you can usually teach it the word. Right-click (or Control-click on Mac) the underlined 'Lumen' and choose 'Add to dictionary' or 'Learn Spelling.' That should stop it from being flagged in all your notes. If that option doesn't appear or the underline keeps coming back, please reply with your device, OS, and whether you're using the web, desktop, or mobile app, and we'll look into it further. Thanks for your patience!

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Keeping work and personal notes separate makes a lot of sense. Best regards, The Lumen Support Team
